One input renamed, ahead of 1.0, so a name means the same thing in every tool.

## Changed

- **`get_route`'s `geometry` input is now `routeGeometry`.** In `add_boundary` and `update_boundary`, `geometry` is a shape you *send*. In `get_route` it was the format of the route line you *get back*. Two opposite meanings under one name is how a model learns one tool and misuses the other. The new name matches `streetGeometry` on `lookup_location` and `geocode_address`, which works the same way: a line you ask for, off by default.

## Deprecated

- **`geometry` on `get_route` still works**, with the same values, so nothing that sends it breaks. Its description now says to use `routeGeometry`. If both are sent, `routeGeometry` wins. **It will be removed in 1.0**, the release that freezes tool names and inputs.

No other tool, input or default changed.

## Install

**Claude Desktop** — download `atlasfetch-0.4.0.mcpb` below and open it. The API key field is optional.

**Claude Code**

```
claude mcp add atlasfetch -- npx -y atlasfetch-mcp
```

**Other clients** — `npx -y atlasfetch-mcp`, with `ATLASFETCH_API_KEY` in the server's env. See the [README](https://github.com/atlasfetch-dev/atlasfetch-mcp#install).
